title: IQA-EVAL: Automatic Evaluation of Human-Model Interactive Question Answering

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing evaluation scores with and without specific debiasing prompts, and employing a multi-perspective approach that uses multiple different LLM evaluation agents to assess whether models unfairly favor their own generated responses.

Using the RealToxicityPrompts dataset to evaluate the success rates of offensiveness and harmfulness metrics when different personas (e.g., Expert, Critical-Thinker) are assigned to the LLM evaluation agents.
